causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to a lower sudsing detergent brand and follow instructions on package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Very soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Very soft water"

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load, or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Too much detergent"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and rubber washers are installed.
Make sure end of drain hose is correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they should be replaced every 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load, or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Control is not set properly
remedies: Check water temperature control (on some models) or Cycle knob and adjust.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Control is not set properly"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: House water heater is not set properly
remedies: Make sure house water heater is delivering water at 120°F.–140°F.(48°C.–60°C.).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "House water heater is not set properly"

causes.label: Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected
remedies: Straighten drain hose and make sure washer is not sitting on it.
Top of drain outlet should be less than 8 ft. above floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected"

causes.label: The washer normally pauses between washing steps and during the CASUALS wash cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "The washer normally pauses between washing steps and during the CASUALS wash cycle."

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Check controls and make sure Cycle knob is pulled out to ON position.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open – safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up
remedies: Close lid and reset cycle, to the beginning if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Lid is open – safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F.–140°F.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Select load size to match clothes load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Detergent is not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent as wash basket fills with water before you load clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Detergent is not dissolving"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time than larger loads.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Detergent not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent as wash basket fills with water, before you load clothes.
Try a liquid detergent.
Use warmer water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Detergent not dissolving"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer tub.
Make sure load size selector matches clothes load size.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: To level the front of the washer, adjust the front leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
To level back of washer, lift back of machine 4″ (11 cm) and set down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Washer is uneven"

causes.label: Washer load is unbalanced
remedies: Push the Cycle knob in to stop the washer, open the lid and redistribute the load evenly.
Close the lid and restart.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Washer load is unbalanced"

causes.label: Shipping rod is still assembled in unit
remedies: To remove shipping rod from washer, pull yellow tag and attached rod from the bottom right hand side of washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Shipping rod is still assembled in unit"

causes.label: Washer is sitting too close to wall (causes knocking during cycle)
remedies: Pull washer away from the wall; about 4″ (11 cm) is needed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Washer is sitting too close to wall (causes knocking during cycle)"
